execution.ref: claude/conditional-exploration from main 992d046b6 (GRAPHITE-CONDITIONAL-EXPLORATION-01, W2 of OWNER-GRAPHITE-TEST-WAVE-03)
execution.description: Built conditional exploration: development expansions in a separate controller ledger that proceed past an open finding, the conditional-evidence.v1 tag on every result recorded while a finding is open, an operator repair record, and one citation check wired into the ladder, level proposals, admission evidence and the LOCK, and a pipeline frozen run.

expected: A finding still refuses every LOCK-path expansion, while exploration on development variants continues. Results recorded while it is open carry its id and digest, and none of them can be cited as established evidence.
observed: Nothing in the existing semantics ever released a finding. Findings are never removed and clear_halt leaves them in place, so 'open until repaired' needed a new operator repair record. The controller's idempotent finding record would also have kept a recurred defect silently repaired, so a repaired finding recorded again now reopens. Track A's LOCK ledger was already exact-key strict, so a separate development ledger kept it unchanged. The citation sites cite files as well as values, and one site (ladder evidence) is a Markdown status file, so the check also reads JSON Lines and Markdown-embedded tags.
keep: One registered rule (conditional-evidence.v1) whose identity every tag records, so the Attacker can test the rule itself.
Tag at the writer (the controller's ledger append and each report builder), not at each caller, so a new caller cannot forget the tag.
One citation check, applied at every place that cites evidence as established, with one mutation per site.
change: When a rule says 'until repaired', check first that the code has a repair event at all; here it did not, and a recurrence path was needed too.
Whether an operator's attestation with the re-run's evidence is enough to release a finding, or a specific re-run record should be required, is open for conditional-evidence.v2.
